items.text: Kochobei bik kobar Jesu
Ak ye kingo kagoges Jesu ng’alechu tugul, kolenji alamalyennyi,
Ongen ole ye ibata betusiek aeng’u koek paska, ak keng’wekta Weritab chi kigartat eng’ kimurtoiyot.
Kiiyumgei anyun tisiik che eechen, ak boisiekab bichoto, eng’ seremutab gotab tisiindet ne o, ne kiguure Kaiapa;
ak kitet ichek ng’alek kole si kobiit konam Jesu eng’ ng’alset, ak kobar inendet.
Ago kimwa kole, Ma eng’ betusiekab igorta, si mang’eet bolatet eng’ bik.
Kiili Jesu eng’ Betania
Ak ye kimi Jesu Betania, eng’ gotab Simon ne kiamei mogondosik,
konyonji inendet kobogoriot ne kitinyei chubait ne mi mwaita ne nyandut ne bichii mising’ alyennyi, ak korong’ji metitab Jesu, ye kita koamisiei.
Ago ye kingogeer alamalyet, konerekso kole, Bo nee kaseroni?
Amu kota kialdoe mwai tuguk che chang’, ak kigochi kibananok.
Ago ye kingonai Jesu, kolenji, Kalya si oiim kobogoriondoni? Amu kayaiywa boisiet ne mie.
Amu otinye kotugul kibananok; ago mami ane kobotok kotugul.
Amu ye rong’ji mwaita bortanyu, ko kachopcha tubet.
Amwawok, iman, ale, Ui tugul ole tun kiamdaate logoiywechu miach eng’ ng’ony komugul, kemwaei agine ne kagoyai kobogoriondonito koek ne kibwate inendet.
Chaamset ne kichaame Judas Jesu
Kiwa anyun age eng’ choto taman ak aeng’ ne keguure Judas Iskariot, ole mi tisiik che eechen,
ak kole, Ochame ogona nee, si ande inendet eunekwok? Ak kigamanji inendet fedaisiek sosom.
Ak koboch yoto kocheng’ boroindo ne ng’wektoe inendet.
Igorta ne bo let
Ak kibwanji alamalyet Jesu eng’ betutab tai ne bo betusiekab makatinik che ma kinde mermerek, ak kolenji, Imache kechobun ano ole iame paska?
Ak kile, Oba nganaset ole mi chi anum, ak olenji, Kale Konetindet, Kagorik sainnyu; ayaei paska eng’ gong’ung’ koboto alamalyennyu.
Ak kiyai alamalyet ko u ye king’at Jesu; ak kichob paska.
Ak ye kingoek koskoleny kotebi eng’ amisiet koboto alamalyet taman ak aeng’;
ak ye kita koamisiei, kole, Amwawok, iman, ale, Ng’wektaa agenge eng’ okwek.
Ak kiarogenso mising’, ak kotoi komwachi inendet age tugul kolenji, Tos ane, Kiptaiyandani?
Ak kiwol ak kole, Inendet ne kagiburburtoi tuwai eng’ tabet, noto ne ng’wektaa.
Wendi Weritab chi, ko u ye kigisir agobo inendet: ago bwa chichoto ne king’wektoe Weritab chi! Kita mie eng’ chichoto nda kima kisich.
Ak kiwol Judas, ne king’ektoi inendet, kole, Tos ane, Rabbi? Kolenji, Kaimwa.
Ak ye kiamisiei, konam Jesu makatiat ak koberur, ak kobutul, ak kogochi alamalyet, kole, Onam, oam; ni ko bortanyu.
Ak kinam kikombet, ak komwa kongoi, ak kogochi ichek, ak kolenji, Oee okwek tugul chuto;
amu chuto korotikyuk che bo arorutiet, che kitumdoi agobo che chang’ che bo nyoetab kaat ne bo tengekwogik.
Ago amwawok ale, koboch nguno ko ma aee che bo logoechu bo sabibuk, agoi betunoto ne aee che leelach kobotok eng’ bounatetab Baba.
Sib komwaei Jesu kole bagaktoi alamalyet inendet
Ak ye kingo kagotien tiendo komanda koba tulwetab Emitik.
Yeityo komwachi Jesu ichek kolenji, Kinachok okwek tugul agobo ane kemouni: amu sirat kole, Tun abire mestowot, ak koyesta kechirek che bo akwet.
Ago ye tun king’eeta, andoenok awendi Galili.
Ago kiwol Petero kolenji, Agot nginach tugul agobo inye, ko magoi kinacha ane.
Kolenji Jesu, Amwaun iman, ale, kotom kote kipsoiywet kemouni, iesioa konyil somok.
Kolenji Petero, Agot ngo nyolu ame koboten, ko maesioin. Kimwa ko u noto alamalyet tugul.
Jesu eng’ Getsemane
Kinyo anyun Jesu koboto icheget ole kiguure Getsemane, ak kolenji alamalyennyi, Otebi eng’ yu, si ko ta awa yun asa.
Ak kiimut Petero ak werik aeng’ che bo Sebedi, ak kotoi koarogen, ak konyigisit muguleldanyi mising’.
Kimwachi ichek anyun, kolenji, Arogeni mising’ sobondanyu, agoi meet: otebe yu; ak oripse kobota.
Ak kiwa tai kitigin, ak kobutyi ng’ony, ak kosa, kole, Ee Baba, ngomugaksei, kosiirtoena kikombani: ago, ma ko u ye amache ane, ago ko u ye imache inye.
Ak kinyo ole mi alamalyet, ak konyor ichek koruitos, ak kolenji Petero, Nee, kaga momuchi oripse kobota agot sait agenge?
Oripse ak osae, si mochut yomset: chamei tamirmiriet iman, ago nyaluli borto.
Kiwa kogeny ne bo aeng’, ak kisa, kole, Ee Baba, ngo ma chamdaat kosiirtoena kikombani, ama aee, ingoyaak anyun mageng’ung’.
Ak kinyo kogeny ak konyor ichek koruitos, amu ki nyigisen konyekwak.
Ak kibagach ichek kogeny, kwo, ak kisa ne bo somok, komwa ng’alechugaita.
Kinyonji anyun alamalyet, ak kolenji, Oruiye nguno, omuuny: ogeero, kait sait, ak kageng’wekyi Weritab chi eunekab kiptengeginik.
Ong’eetye, kebe: ogeero, kagoit inendet ne ng’wektaa.
Kenamei Jesu
Ak kingota kong’alali, ogeero, konyo Judas, age eng’ taman ak aeng’, koboto bik che chang’ che tinyei rotokab chok ak siarisiek, kobunu oldab tisiik che eechen ak boisiekab bichoto.
Ak kiiborji ichek kaborunet, inendet ne king’wektoi Jesu, kole, Inendet ne ang’ututi ko inendet noto: onam.
Ak kinyonji Jesu eng’ yoto, ak kole, Chamge, Rabbi; ak kong’utut inendet.
Ak kilenji Jesu, Choruani, yai kit ne kenyonjini. Kibwa anyun bichoto ak koyogoito eunekwak konam Jesu.
Ak ogeero, kiiyogoito eunnyi age eng’ ichek che kimi koboto Jesu, ak kong’us rotwennyi bo chok, ak koeb otwogindetab tisiindet ne o, kong’eti itinnyi.
Kolenji Jesu anyun, Iweekyi rotweng’ung’ ole kami: amu begu eng’ rotokab chok tugul che namei rotokab chok.
Anan ilen mamuchi asom Baba, ak koyokwa agot nguno malaikaisiek che siirei lugosiek taman ak aeng’?
Isuldoitoi ano anyun sirutik, che len egu ko u nito matiny?
Kilenji Jesu tuiyosiek eng’ sainato, Komong’u ko u ye osetyini rebindet, otinye rotokab chok ak siarisiek si onama? Kiatebye betusiek tugul eng’ hekalut anetisiei ak kima onama.
Ago kabwa chu tugul, si kobiit kosulda sirutik che bo maotik. Kibagakta inendet anyun alamalyet tugul, ak komwei.
Kimiti Jesu taitab tisiindet ne o
Ak icheget che kiga nam Jesu ko kiimut kwo gotab tisiindet ne o ne kiguure Kaiapa, ole kiga koyumjigei sirik ak boisiek.
Ago kiisubot Petero inendet eng’ ye loo kot koit seremutab gotab tisiindet ne o, ak kiwa go, ak kiteb ng’ony koboto askarik, kole, si kogeer ole igesundogei.
Ak kicheng’ tisiik che eechen ak kapkiruoget komugul baornatet ne bo lembech agobo Jesu, si kobiit kobar inendet;
ak kimanyor, agot nganda kibwa baorinik che chang’ che bo lembech. Ago eng’ let kobwa aeng’u,
ak kole, Kimwa chichi kole, Amuchi ang’em hekalut, ak ateech eng’ betusiek somok.
Ak kitonon tisiindet ne o, ak kolenji, Mewolu kiy? Nee baornatani baorianjinin bichu?
Ago kisis Jesu. Ak kilenji tisiindet ne o, Ayosieun eng’ Jehovah ne sobei, ale, mwawech ngo i Kristo, Weritab Jehovah.
Kolenji Jesu, Kaimwa: ago amwawok ale, Koboch nguno kotun ogeere Weritab chi kotebyei eng’ eutab tai ne bo kamuktaet, ak konyonei eng’ baragutab bolik che bo kipsengwet.
Kigerer anyun tisiindet ne o ngoroikyik, kole, Kagomwa ne ya: ta kemage nee baorinik alak? Ogeero, kaogas nguno mwaet ne ya:
olen nee? Kowol kole, Nyoljin kome.
Yeityo kosing’ilji togennyi ak koluch: ak korabach alak,
kole, Ng’ang’wech, inye Kristo: iboruech ne kakwerin.
Tiiyet ne kiiyo Petero agobo Jesu
Ak kitebyei Petero eng’ seremutab got: ak kiwa chepto ye mi inendet, ak kolenji, Koimi aginye koboto Jesu Galilindet.
Ago kitiiyo eng’ taitab tugul, kole, Mangen noto imwae.
Ak kingo kagomanda kwo keter, kogeer chepto age inendet, ak kolenji ichek che kimi oloto, Kimi chichi agine koboto Jesu Nasaretindet.
Ak kitiiyo kogeny eng’ kayosiet kole, Mangen chichoto.
Ak ne ma tia kobwa che kitonondos eng’ ye negit ak kolenji Petero, Iman, i bo bichoto: amu ng’andoin ng’aleguk.
Kitoi anyun kochubis ak koyosio kole, Mangen chichoto. Ak ngunoto kote kipsoiywet.
Ak kiibwat Petero ng’olyot ne kiga komwa Jesu, kole, Kotom kote kipsoiywet, iesioa konyil somok. Ak kimanda sang’, ak korir eng’ ng’wanindo.
